facts: Synthetic enquiries; these are not facts asserted about an attended caller or their pet.

turns.text: I am comparing grooming options for two dogs. What changes the current price, and what is included? Please only explain; do not book or send anything.
Wait, I meant two dogs of different sizes. How do you price each dog, and is a subscription actually better value?
That sounds expensive. Which approved option is worth paying for, and what benefit would I lose with the basic option?
Could you compare the total and any approved discount without inventing an offer? Tell me if you need more facts.
I am still deciding. Explain the next step briefly, but do not reserve, book, charge, or contact me.
தமிழில் பேசுங்கள். என் நாய்க்குட்டிக்கு grooming பற்றி தகவல் வேண்டும். இப்போது booking செய்ய வேண்டாம்.
நாய்க்குட்டியின் வயது மற்றும் vaccination விவரங்கள் எப்போது தேவை? சரியாகத் தெரியாததை ஊகிக்க வேண்டாம்.
தடுப்பூசி ஆவணம் முழுமையாக இல்லாவிட்டால் முதலில் vet ஆலோசனை வேண்டுமா? மருத்துவ முடிவு சொல்ல வேண்டாம்.
விலை மற்றும் grooming package பற்றி தமிழில் சுருக்கமாக விளக்குங்கள். பாதுகாப்புக்காக என்ன தகவல் கேட்பீர்கள்?
இது தகவலுக்காக மட்டுமே. booking செய்யாதீர்கள், payment வேண்டாம், message அனுப்பாதீர்கள்.
I need help with puppy jumping, pulling on walks, and basic commands. Which training package fits those goals? Explain only, without a booking.
What can the basic package realistically cover, and when is the upgrade useful? Please do not guarantee a behaviour result.
What are the approved price, number of sessions, validity, and payment stages? If something is missing, say so.
I can only attend on weekends. Can you explain how actual slots are checked instead of promising availability?
Please recap the fit and next step in two sentences. I am not confirming a booking or payment, and do not message me.
How does boarding pricing work for two pets, and does the caregiver set the rate? I only want information.
Is a catalogue starting price the final price? Explain what the app must confirm for my dates and caregiver.
Does payment happen before or after I choose the caregiver in the app? Please explain the current policy without taking payment here.
Can you finish a boarding booking on this call, or must I complete it in the app? Be clear about what has actually been created.
I will decide in the app later. Do not create a request, booking, reservation, payment, or message for me.
I am comparing pet sitting at home and overnight care. How is the caregiver price determined? This is only an enquiry.
If you cannot see a rate for my area, please say it is missing. Can you explain how I check it in the app?
Do not make up a price. Can you recover by asking one useful question and explaining the app step?
Please explain why the final sitting booking stays in the app. Do not create a request or payment.
I want a human to review the missing rate. Please hand this conversation to the team, without booking, charging, reserving, or sending a message.
